bio.text: Trygve Hammer is the Democratic-NPL candidate for North Dakota's at-large U.S. House seat in 2026 and is challenging Rep. Julie Fedorchak for a second time.
He graduated from Velva High School and the U.S. Naval Academy (1990) and served in the U.S. Marine Corps, including as a helicopter pilot and forward air controller.
Ballotpedia lists his later career experience as airline pilot, defense contractor, security consultant and writer.
